title: The demo that became 'I'll Never Smile Again'
summary: A woman in a wheelchair gave Leeman and Carmen Mastren a demo, and after a week or two they got Dorsey to hear 'I'll Never Smile Again'.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
story.community_name: Working with Sinatra: bands, Vegas and the Sands

blocks.x: buildings now where it's a yearly annual thing. And we played in a huge tent, and it was a young crippled lady in a wheelchair that came back and asked us if we would play a demo, asked Carmen Masfrjen and myself, the guitar player, Carmen Masfrjen, if we'd see if Tommy would play this demo.

Well, when we returned to New York, we tried for about a week or two to get Tom, between sets, to go into a back room that we had up at the Pennsylvania Roof and listen to this record. And we couldn't get him to do it, but eventually he came in and listened to it, and that song turned out to be 'I'll Never Smile Again,' which after I left in a few months, Frank recorded, and I guess that's the story of that.
